title: chore: autonomous work queue; govulncheck in make check
body:
## Summary

Sessions now work the backlog on their own. A session finishes any open agent MR, then picks up open tickets in dependency order and delivers each one through to merge. A ticket that needs a product decision gets the question posted on it and the `needs-pm` label, and the session moves on to the next ticket.

## Changes

- New `work-queue` skill. The SessionStart hook makes it the default when no specific instruction is given.
- No approval gates. AC are either stated by the PM or derived by Opus from `docs/design.md`, citing the section. When composer asks for plan approval, the session approves it as engineering lead.
- Agent comments are prefixed with `🤖 ` so PM replies on parked tickets can be told apart.
- CLAUDE.md, ADR 0003, ticket-kickoff, ticket-workflow, ship-it and product-voice updated to match.
- `make check` now also runs `govulncheck` (pinned at v1.8.0; Renovate tracks it through a custom manager).
- New `needs-pm` label, applied to #13.

## Verification

- `make check`: `No vulnerabilities found.`, lint `0 issues.`, build ok
- `renovate-config-validator --strict`: `Config validated successfully`
- hooks: `50 passed, 0 failed`

## Decisions

- Opus: govulncheck runs through `go run` with a pinned version, so neither CI nor local setup needs an install step.

title: docs: onboarding, Settings screen, TOML config (ADR 0004)
body:
## Summary

Setup moves into the app: a first-run onboarding flow, and a Settings screen (`S`) that saves to a TOML config. There's no database.

## Changes

- **design.md:** new Onboarding section (7 steps: welcome → forge type → address → sign in → connection test → Renovate bot → name and save) and Settings section. `S` added to the keymap; onboarding and settings added to the v1 scope.
- **architecture.md:** "Configuration and stored state": `config.toml` (managed by the app), `state.toml` (remembered values), token rules, atomic writes.
- **ADR 0004:** TOML files with no database; `BurntSushi/toml`.

Tickets updated: #5 is now "Onboarding, Settings screen and TOML config", and #8 gains demo mode (`--demo`) for safe UI development and verification.

## Needs PM approval before merge

This changes `docs/design.md`. The requirement (onboarding, editing config in the UI, TOML) came from the PM; the step list and the `S` key are engineering's proposal.

## Decisions

- Opus: TOML via `BurntSushi/toml`; separate state file; pasted tokens allowed only with `0600` permissions (ADR 0004).

title: chore: set up how we work: roles, skills, hooks, Go scaffold, CI, Renovate
body:
## Summary

Sets up how lazyforge gets built: roles, the ticket → composer → merge flow, project skills and hooks, a Go scaffold with CI, and Renovate onboarding. Also records the PM's install and update requirements in the design.

## What's in it

- **CLAUDE.md**: the PM owns product, Opus owns engineering decisions, Sonnet consults Opus, and Fable gives second opinions. Plan approval is the only PM gate. Agents merge their own MRs once review passes and CI is green.
- **Skills**: `product-voice` (loaded every session), `engineering-decision`, `go-development`, `comment-standard`, `ticket-workflow`, `ticket-kickoff` (routes to composer / composer-lite / inline), `ship-it`.
- **Hooks**: Go edits and commits are blocked until `go-development` (plus `comment-standard` for production Go) has been loaded, and there's a reminder to run ship-it after inline work. Hook test suite: `50 passed, 0 failed`.
- **ADRs**: 0001 Go + Charm; 0002 forge adapters, one host per session; 0003 roles and decision authority.
- **Scaffold**: Go module, `make check` (format check, golangci-lint v2, race tests, build), `.golangci.yml`, CI on PRs and pushes to develop/main.
- **Renovate**: `renovate.json` targeting `develop`, with `opus`/`sonnet` driver labels (validated: `Config validated successfully`).
- **design.md**: install script and startup update check added to v1, plus two new open questions.

## Verification

- `make check`: `0 issues.` from lint; tests pass (no test files yet); build ok.
- `golangci-lint config verify`: ok.

## Backlog

Tickets #1–#13 are filed: three spikes, the v1 features, release/install (#11), the update check (#12), and the product decisions that need the PM (#13).

## Decisions

- Opus: CI runs on `ubuntu-latest` (the instance-wide runners), not `ci`, which serves the kirria org.
- Opus: agent MRs are squash-merged.
